title: 第七百章 好消息第六百九十九章 干了大事
content_zh:
第七百章好消息
看着诸多师弟这样一副被清净经荼毒良久的模样，宋诚仿佛间也是想到了他以前，修行的时候的情景。
紧接着，他则是对着众人开口道:
“贫道手中的这一棵草，并不是你们口中的芝草，也不是什么宝药，而是另一个世界之中接受灵气浸润的一棵普通小草。”
“这就是贫道随手在地上拔的东西。”
“在另一个世界之中，这种类型的草就是农民眼中的野草，是畜牧牛羊吃的草料，就是最普通的东西。”
轰！！
话语落下。
在场之中的众人直接就炸了。
“什么？这样的宝物在另一个世界之中，是随手可得的？”
“不可能！绝对不可能！”
“这该是一个怎么样的世界啊？难不成真是传说中的仙界不成？”
“……”
刚刚还压得住心中躁动的众人，现如今一时间也是不由得纷纷交头接耳。
甚至开口说着自己心中的想法。
不可思议。
这实在是太不可思议了。
这样对他们修行极有益处，能够促进他们修行的东西，在另一个世界之中就是杂草。
他们接受不了！
就好像自己求而不得的东西，在别人手中，却弃之如敝履。

他们能只是交谈一番，发泄一下心中的想法，这就已经算得上是心境修行的十分了得了。
没给他们三观崩了就不错了。
深吸一口气之后，便见到黑木山则是认真的对着面前的大师兄开口问道:
“大师兄，您是说另一个世界之中到处都是这种野草？”
说到野草的时候，黑木山还顿了顿。
嘴角猛地一抽。
好像是不知道该怎么形容一样。
而听到了黑木山如此询问，宋诚则是点了点头:
“另一个世界之中，天地环境非常的优越，甚至优越到了我等不可想象的地步。”
“另一个世界之中的普通人，呼吸的灵气都是我们求而不得的，我们这一方世界太贫瘠了，任何另一个世界的东西放在这里都是宝物。”
“你等在此界难以跨越那天人间隔，难以成仙，但是在另一个世界却可以！”
“这也是贫道来寻诸位师弟的原因……”
虽然同样都是踏入通窍境界，在另一个世界之中同样被称为仙。
content_en:
Chapter 700 Good News
Seeing the many junior disciples who looked like they had been poisoned by the Purity Sutra for a long time, Song Cheng seemed to suddenly think of his previous scenes when he was practicing.
Immediately afterwards, he spoke to everyone:
"The grass in the hand of this poor Taoist is not the Zhicao you call it, nor is it a precious medicine. It is an ordinary grass infiltrated by spiritual energy in another world."
"This is what I picked up from the ground."
"In another world, this type of grass is what farmers see as weeds. It is the fodder for cattle and sheep. It is the most common thing."
Boom! !
The words fell.
Everyone present immediately exploded.
"What? Such treasures are readily available in another world?"
"Impossible! Absolutely impossible!"
"What kind of world is this? Is it really the legendary fairyland?"
"..."
Everyone who had been able to suppress their restlessness just now could not help but whisper among themselves.
He even spoke out his thoughts.
Incredible.
This is really incredible.
This is extremely beneficial to their practice, and the things that can promote their practice are just weeds in another world.
They can't accept it!
It's like what you can't get is in the hands of others, but you throw it away like worn out shoes.
They can just have a conversation and vent their thoughts, which can be regarded as a very remarkable state of mind cultivation.
It would be nice if they didn't lose their outlook on life.
After taking a deep breath, he saw Heimushan seriously asking the senior brother in front of him:
"Senior Brother, are you saying that there are such weeds everywhere in another world?"
When talking about weeds, Heimushan paused.
The corners of his mouth twitched sharply.
It's like I don't know how to describe it.
After hearing Heimushan's question, Song Cheng nodded:
"In another world, the environment of heaven and earth is very superior, even superior to a point that we can't imagine."
"Ordinary people in another world can't get the aura they breathe. Our world is too barren. Anything from another world is a treasure here."
"It's hard for you to cross the gap between people in this world and become an immortal in this world, but you can in another world!"
"This is also the reason why Pindao came to look for you junior brothers..."
Although they have also entered the realm of enlightenment, they are also called immortals in another world.
